title: Fix now in millis for ESQL search contexts

timeline.message: Fix nowInMillis for ESQL search contexts
timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen

timeline.body:
Currently, ESQL search contexts do not have the correct actual 'now' in milliseconds. Ideally, we should use a consistent 'now' in millis for all nodes participating in the execution of a search request. I will follow up with a PR to deserialize that value between nodes for version 8.13 and later.

Closes #103455

timeline.body: Hi @dnhatn, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Can we not use the inherited `now()` instead?

reply.body: It seems that `now` will be adjusted with the timezone?

It is, but I guess we could (have) convert(ed) that to `Z`? We'd get the serialisation "for free". If feels a bit odd to have two time methods on `EsqlConfiguration.java`, but I guess this works for now (so to "say") too :)

timeline.body: Left one comment, it otherwise LGTM.
